# Who What Wear

> > Who What Wear is a leading fashion and style publication offering expert fashion advice, celebrity style coverage, shopping guides, and exclusive discount codes for fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands.

Who What Wear provides fashion editorial content from experienced editors like Layla Al-Ani, Shona Moreland, Becky Spicer, and Kristen Nichols, covering trends, celebrity style, and shopping recommendations. The site also features comprehensive promo code listings for major retailers and emerging brands, with special discounts for students through partnerships with Student Beans and UNiDAYS.

## Key Topics

- Fashion Editorial & Style Advice
- Celebrity Style Coverage
- Shopping Guides & Product Recommendations
- Discount Codes & Promo Offers
- Student Discounts (Student Beans, UNiDAYS)
- Loyalty Programs & Rewards
- Black Friday & Cyber Monday Deals
- Denim & Jeans Expertise
- Beauty & Skincare Recommendations
- Luxury Fashion & Designer Brands
- Free Shipping Offers
- Return & Exchange Policies
- Fashion Dupes & Affordable Alternatives
- Activewear & Athleisure
- Seasonal Fashion Trends
